test_title: PYST 46: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters Q, Z, V, T, L and A are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fe94bb141efb37b5ea58905f675e7a3da0fdd4d621ea3a6b49051b497397f20.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As V is common on both the dices, it is clear that Q, Z, T, and L are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. A will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17bf31b1f9761df37d2c8b4b11fde76744683b72e34cb96f00ab992edec040c0.png] 

Opposite pairs:

Z → L

Q → T

V → A

So, the opposite side of "Q" will be side "T".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
